description: Shows the outcome of a buffered position for a given index return, buffer size and cap over one outcome period. Same math as https://www.vistashares.com/buffer-etf-calculator/.

buffer_pct.description: Buffer size, in percent of losses absorbed first. Accepts 0 to 100; default 10.

cap_pct.description: Cap on gains, in percent. Accepts 0 to 200; default 12.

index_return_pct.description: Index return over the outcome period, in percent. Accepts -100 to 200; default -15.

name: buffer_outcome
title: Buffer ETF outcome calculator
